[[Moana Pasifika]] {{small|([[Super Rugby]]) (2024–present)}} | capacity = 10,000 }} '''Teufaiva Sport Stadium''' which was previously known as ''Tenefaira Field Stadium'' is a [[multi-purpose stadium]] in [[Nukuʻalofa|Nuku{{Okina}}alofa]], [[Tonga]]. It is used mostly for [[rugby union]], [[football (soccer)|football]] and [[rugby league]] and the Ikale Tahi team matches. The stadium holds 10,000 people. It is the home ground of the [[Tonga national rugby union team]].{{cite web|last1=Thomas|first1=Chris|title=Attention NRL: A glorious future awaits in the Pacific|url=http://www.theroar.com.au/2014/03/13/attention-nrl-a-glorious-future-awaits-in-the-pacific/|publisher=The Roar|accessdate=31 March 2016}} Teufaiva is where the Secondary School sports in Tonga are held (every year). The stadium fell into disrepair in the early 2000s and was unused for eight years. It was reopened after being refurbished in 2017,{{cite web |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/333380/teufaiva-reopening-makes-tongan-rugby-whole-again-vunipola |title=Teufaiva reopening makes Tongan rugby whole again: Vunipola |publisher=[[RNZ]] |date=20 June 2017 |accessdate=30 January 2021}} but badly damaged by [[Cyclone Gita]] just a few months later.{{cite web |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/350804/newly-refurbished-tonga-stadium-badly-damaged-by-gita |title=Newly refurbished Tonga stadium badly damaged by Gita |publisher=[[RNZ]] |date=20 February 2018 |accessdate=30 January 2021}} It was re-opened again in 2019.{{cite web |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/364126/sport-tonga-s-teufaiva-stadium-set-to-re-open |title=Sport: Tonga's Teufaiva Stadium set to re-open |publisher=[[RNZ]] |date=15 August 2019 |accessdate=30 January 2021}} On the 4th of May 2024, [[Moana Pasifika]], from the [[Super Rugby Pacific]] competition hosted their first game at the stadium against the [[Highlanders (rugby union)|Highlanders]] ([[Dunedin]], [[New Zealand]]).{{Cite web |title=Historic First Match In Tonga |url=https://super.rugby/superrugby/news/historic-first-match-in-tonga/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=Super Rugby Pacific |language=en}} The Highlanders won 28-17 in wet conditions.{{Cite web |title=Highlanders hold off Pasifika in historic Super clash |url=https://super.rugby/superrugby/news/highlanders-hold-off-pasifika-in-historic-super-clash/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=Super Rugby Pacific |language=en}} This made Tonga the 12th country to
